fusions.name: Arcane Spray
fusions.desc: Flicks a spark of arcana that deals 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Resonant Swell
fusions.desc: A swell of arcana that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Slack Water
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Glimmer
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded glimmer that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds within 5 tiles.
